rationale: The reliable witnessed attachment on 4 June precedes the witnessed binding on 7 June. The safeguarded continuity and matching identifiers establish that both events concern the same D-17 packet. This bounded event-order claim requires no inference about earlier composition, unobserved rearrangements, or authorial intention.

signal_basis.exact_text: Two reliable witnesses record the identified opening leaves being attached to D-17 on 4 June.
A continuous safeguarded chain connects that packet to a witnessed binding of D-17 on 7 June.
The identifiers match at each transfer and no unexplained transition occurs in that interval.
The stated witnesses, identifiers and safeguarding are reliable.
